slots.rationale: C8: the standing Devotions box says 6:30 pm and the dated Monday listing of both weeks says 6:15 PM; the website gives no Adoration time. Leaning 6:15 because the weekly listing is re-edited each week, repeats it in both issues, and Adoration must end before the 6:30 PM Mass. The chapel is taken to be in the church (same listing as the church's Masses).

slots.rationale: R6, R29: the parish website (homepage and mass.html, checked 2026-11-22, carrying this week's Presentation reflection and (c) 2026) lists it with the Italian First Friday Mass. Neither bulletin prints it, though the bulletins print the Italian Mass, and the newest covers a third Sunday (Nov 15) whose intentions list only 9, 10:30, 12 and 5. A missing mention is not a conflict, and a Spanish Mass may carry no intention, so leaning include; but whether it continues is in doubt.
